ORIGINAL USMLE-STYLE PRACTICE

Localizing versus withdrawal

An adult with impaired consciousness does not follow commands. During an appropriate head-and-neck pressure stimulus, he purposefully brings his hand above the clavicle toward the stimulus. There is no paralysis or limb injury. Which best motor score describes this response?

  1. M2: extension
  2. M5: localizing
  3. M6: obeying commands
  4. M4: normal flexion
  5. M3: abnormal flexion
Answer and explanation

M5: localizing

A purposeful movement toward the head-and-neck stimulus is localizing.

Option explanations

M5: localizing: A purposeful movement toward the head-and-neck stimulus is localizing.

M6: obeying commands: No command following is demonstrated.

M4: normal flexion: Simple flexion away from a stimulus is different from purposeful localization.

M3: abnormal flexion: This requires a predominantly abnormal flexion pattern.

M2: extension: Extension is not the movement described.
